text.headline: Timeline of Tajikistan
text.text: Major events in the history of Tajikistan.

events.headline: Ancient Sogdiana
events.text: Part of Sogdiana, an ancient Persian civilization and Silk Road hub.

events.headline: Samanid Empire
events.text: Samanids promote Persian culture and Islamic scholarship.

events.headline: Russian Expansion
events.text: Tajik lands under Russian control within the Emirate of Bukhara.

events.headline: Tajik SSR Formed
events.text: Becomes a Soviet republic within the USSR.

events.headline: Independence
events.text: Declares independence following the USSR collapse.

events.headline: Civil War
events.text: Conflict between government and Islamist factions.

events.headline: Hydropower Projects
events.text: Rogun Dam development signals economic push.

events.headline: Regional Cooperation
events.text: Deepening ties through trade and security accords.
